title: pre_write_cleanup
description: Event: marker recorded by a writer immediately before it clears the entry it is about to rewrite. The invalidate event that FOLLOWS this marker in the same scope's event stream is pre-write cleanup, not a real invalidation. The purpose is recorded at the source (QueryRepository::doPut(), DonutRepository::putStatic()/putDonut()), so readers never infer cleanup-vs-invalidation from tag correlation: an invalidate not immediately preceded by this marker is a real invalidation.

uri.description: URI of the resource whose stale entry is being cleared before the rewrite
